reviews.title: Good quality, roomy, cute, functional
reviews.body: I’ve been using this for a few weeks now for work. I really like it. It’s roomy, easy to carry, and doesn’t take up too much room in our work fridge. I use one block ice pack and it keeps my food at a good temperature. I’m able to put 2 Tupperware containers, yogurt, banana, canned drinks, plus chips and still have room for more if needed. The loop handles are large enough for me to carry on my wrists so I can free up my hands to carry other things.  The zipper is great- doesn’t get stuck and easy to zip open and close.  Overall I’m really happy with it and glad I got this over other ones I was looking at.

The material seems a little flimsy/thin, but it still has kept my food cold and it lasted fine in the washing machine. The green stripe is also super cute, I'd recommend this product.

reviews.title: Fits Everything I need without being overstuffed
reviews.body: I use this lunch box every single day, and it has been such a reliable staple for my routine. It’s surprisingly spacious and easily fits my breakfast, lunch, and snacks without being overstuffed. I love that it has a dedicated compartment for silverware. The insulation works really well too. I just toss in a freezer pack in the morning, and my food stays cool throughout the entire day. It’s perfect for long workdays when I need everything to hold up for hours. Overall, it’s functional, well-designed, and makes packing meals so much easier.
